description: This file contains functions and type definitions for resolving Discord users, including parsing user input, scoring members, and resolving users via an allowlist with guild and member data fetching.

methods.name: parseDiscordUserInput
methods.description: Parses raw user input string to extract user ID, guild ID, guild name, and username.

methods.name: scoreDiscordMember
methods.description: Scores a Discord member based on how well they match a query string.

methods.name: resolveDiscordUserAllowlist
methods.description: Resolves a list of user input strings to Discord user data, using guild and member searches.
